  t1.PROD_CD AS "상품코드",
  t1.PAY_TERM_YR AS "납입기간년수",
  t1.CHNL_CD AS "모집채널코드",
  t1.TERM_DT AS "해지일자"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
ORDER BY
  t1.MON_PRM DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "모집채널",
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "비율"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.CHNL_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'CHNL'
GROUP BY
  t1.CHNL_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM
ORDER BY
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) DESC

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "비율"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM TB_PAY AS x1
    WHERE
      x1.CTRT_NO = t1.CTRT_NO AND x1.DLQ_YN = 'Y' AND x1.DLQ_DAYS >= 3
  )

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "비율"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
ORDER BY
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) DESC
LIMIT 25

SELECT
  SUBSTRING(t1.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS "월",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20261231'
GROUP BY
  SUBSTRING(t1.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
ORDER BY
  SUBSTRING(t1.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) ASC

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "비율"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
ORDER BY
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) DESC

SELECT
  t1.TCKT_ID AS "상담티켓ID",
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CTRT_NO AS "관련계약번호",
  t1.RCPT_DT AS "접수일자",
  t1.CMPL_DT AS "처리완료일자",
  t1.CHNL_CD AS "접수채널코드"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.RCPT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20261231' AND t1.PROC_STAT_CD = '01'
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  AVG(t2.DLQ_DAYS) AS "연체일수_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_PAY AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
WHERE
  t2.DLQ_DAYS >= 2

SELECT
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.ZIP_CD AS "우편번호",
  t1.TELNO AS "휴대전화번호",
  t1.EMAIL AS "이메일주소",
  t1.JOIN_DT AS "최초거래일자",
  t1.RGN_CD AS "거주지역코드"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CUST_NM AS "고객명",
  t1.GNDR_CD AS "성별코드",
  t1.ZIP_CD AS "우편번호",
  t1.ADDR AS "주소",
  t1.TELNO AS "휴대전화번호"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CUST_NM AS "고객명",
  t1.ZIP_CD AS "우편번호",
  t1.VIP_GRD_CD AS "고객등급코드",
  t1.GNDR_CD AS "성별코드",
  t1.ADDR AS "주소"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "청구상태",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.CLM_STAT_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'CLM_STAT'
GROUP BY
  t1.CLM_STAT_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CUST_NM AS "고객명",
  t1.GNDR_CD AS "성별코드",
  t1.ZIP_CD AS "우편번호",
  t1.ADDR AS "주소",
  t1.EMAIL AS "이메일주소"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  t1.TCKT_ID AS "상담티켓ID",
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CTRT_NO AS "관련계약번호",
  t1.RCPT_DT AS "접수일자",
  t1.CMPL_DT AS "처리완료일자",
  t1.CHNL_CD AS "접수채널코드"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
LIMIT 200
